milestone: STORAGE-LIFECYCLE-P5B -- controlled production HOT/COLD atomic cutover
authorization: Explicit human final authorization, given directly in-conversation, following a staged checkpoint review of Stage 3A pre-switch reconciliation.
executed_by: Orchestrating session directly, visibly, in-conversation -- NOT a background/subagent dispatch, per explicit human instruction after Claude Code's own auto-mode permission classifier declined an earlier attempt to dispatch the switch as a background agent action.

final_micro_cycle.reason: Production writers were running against the old DB while the human reviewed the Stage 3A/3B checkpoint. Per explicit instruction, one final micro-quiesce/reconcile cycle was required before the atomic switch.

zero_writer_proof.write_lock_state: benign stale RELEASE_PENDING record from a known non-transfer-writer process (rpc_metrics_recorder.py), zero waiters

final_identity_reconciliation.method: Streaming XOR-combined SHA256 digest over composite key (signature, source, destination, amount_lamports, block_time), bounded to id<=6835535

atomic_switch.mechanism: Two POSIX same-filesystem renames (device id 16777231 confirmed identical for database/ and database/_p5a_migration_build/ via stat -f): (1) database/flex_complete_database.db -> database/flex_complete_database.db.p5b_rollback_quarantine, (2) database/_p5a_migration_build/replacement_main.db -> database/flex_complete_database.db. No copy performed -- atomic, near-instant.

old_db_quarantine.note: Verified post-switch: quarantined file's MAX(id) and row count remain exactly frozen at 6835535/5393999 with no writes reaching it after the switch. Never deleted, VACUUMed, modified, or repurposed. Remains the rollback source through the observation window and beyond, until a separate P5C retirement decision.

writer_downtime.note: ~5m54s total, dominated by the deliberate care taken at each verification step (zero-writer proof polling, final delta reconciliation, full identity reconciliation scan, atomic switch, runtime-target verification) rather than by the switch itself, which took 6.8 milliseconds.

first_new_write_proof.method: Observed genuine organic production traffic for ~45+ seconds after service restart.
first_new_write_proof.new_rows_confirmed_real: Sampled 3 latest rows -- genuine, distinct signatures, current block_times, consistent with normal listener activity

production_cold_read_proof.method: Constructed a real TransferReaderFactory pointed at the NEW live production path (database/flex_complete_database.db, post-switch) + the real COLD segment root, queried a genuine COLD-only historical signature.
production_cold_read_proof.result: 1 row correctly retrieved via the new production path

funding_structure.method: data-level fetch_discovery_intake_candidates() count, not source-code grep

application_health.lock_errors_in_logs: none found in the Part 4-onward window

rollback_readiness.rollback_procedure_if_needed: 1. quiesce all 3 writers, 2. prove zero writers, 3. mv database/flex_complete_database.db.p5b_rollback_quarantine back to database/flex_complete_database.db (reversing the same atomic rename), 4. verify identity via row count/MAX(id), 5. restart all 3 services, 6. verify health.

p5c_status: NOT AUTHORIZED -- old DB retirement/deletion remains a separate, future milestone requiring its own explicit human authorization after the observation window.
